name: frostguard
description: FROSTGUARD — enterprise cold-chain intelligence, monitoring and traceability platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @frostguard/api && npm run build -w @frostguard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @frostguard/api && npm run typecheck -w @frostguard/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:sql && npm run db:seed
